anchors.description: Dining table height: near tabletop corner above the carved front leg down to that leg's foot on the floor
anchors.visible_evidence: Brown wooden dining table with carved corner leg and block foot; the near tabletop corner is visible directly above the leg, and the leg foot rests on the visible hardwood floor.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Assumed standard-height dining table (~0.75 m); a counter-height table would be ~0.90 m but the matching wooden dining chairs make standard height far more likely.

anchors.description: Dining chair seat height: top of the near right chair's seat at its front edge down to the floor at the front leg foot
anchors.visible_evidence: Tall-backed wooden dining chair at the right side of the table; its seat front edge and the front leg reaching the visible hardwood floor are both clear.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Standard dining chair seat height varies 0.44-0.47 m; the cushion/upholstery thickness adds a little uncertainty.

anchors.description: Paper towel roll height: top edge of the white roll to its bottom edge where it meets the tabletop
anchors.visible_evidence: White cylindrical paper towel roll standing upright on the tabletop near the window, with a dark finial of the holder visible just above it; both roll ends are visible.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Standard US kitchen roll is ~0.28 m tall, but the roll could be partly used and the finial overlaps the top edge.
